items.docs: Upload one or more files to a specified bucket. Supports batch uploading with optional custom metadata for each file. If uploading multiple files, either provide metadata for all files or none.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the file to download

params.name: q
params.description: Image quality (1-100). Only applies to JPEG, WebP and PNG files

params.name: h
params.description: Maximum height to resize image to while maintaining aspect ratio. Only applies to image files

params.name: w
params.description: Maximum width to resize image to while maintaining aspect ratio. Only applies to image files

params.name: b
params.description: Blur the image using this sigma value. Only applies to image files

params.name: f
params.description: Output format for image files. Use 'auto' for content negotiation based on Accept header

items.docs: Retrieve and download the complete file content. Supports conditional requests, image transformations, and range requests for partial downloads.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the file to replace

items.docs:
Replace an existing file with new content while preserving the file ID. The operation follows these steps:
1. The isUploaded flag is set to false to mark the file as being updated
2. The file content is replaced in the storage backend
3. File metadata is updated (size, mime-type, isUploaded, etc.)

Each step is atomic, but if a step fails, previous steps will not be automatically rolled back.

params.name: id
params.description: Unique identifier of the file to delete

items.docs: Permanently delete a file from storage. This removes both the file content and its associated metadata.
